description: Claims of the walkthroughs (qa/acceptance, from the Lee guide and the SSI Clue Book) that the game's own data contradicts: errors of the guides, not of the port. npm run qa:guide-claims accepts each as settled while its claim still has no match for exactly the reason recorded in noMatch, from the GOG 1.3 files and from game/ (#113).

errata.claim: 1 ORC LEADER (#15), 3 ORC LEADER (#14), 16 ORC (#4), Morale 70, 412 XP
errata.guide: 16 ORC (#4) with the orc leaders at location 9 (3,3)
errata.data: 20 ORC: LOAD MONSTER byte 4, byte 20 after #15 x1 and #14 x3
errata.where: ECL2.DAX block 20 at 0xa9fa (0xa9ec, 0xa9f3 for the leaders)
errata.noMatch: #4 is loaded 3 or 8 or 20 or 30, not 16

errata.claim: 11 GOBLIN LEADER (#3) + 12 GOBLIN GUARD (#2), Morale 60, 65 XP
errata.guide: 11 GOBLIN LEADER (#3) with 12 GOBLIN GUARD at location 15 (3,11)
errata.data: 21 GOBLIN LEADER: LOAD MONSTER byte 3, byte 21 after #2 x12
errata.where: ECL2.DAX block 20 at 0xac43 (0xac3c for the guards)

errata.claim: 1 jewelry, 50 pp, 40 gold, 3 random magic items
errata.guide: 40 gold with 1 jewelry, 50 pp and 3 random magic items at location 20 (0,14)
errata.data: 30 gold: TREASURE copper 0, silver 0, electrum 0, gold 30, platinum 50, gems 0, jewelry 1, item 131 (3 random)
errata.noMatch: no TREASURE with 40 gold, 50 platinum, 1 jewelry

errata.claim: Location 20: '3 TROLL (#1) [sic]', 3 WILD BOAR, 20 KOBOLD, 4 KOBOLD LEADER, Morale 100, 522 XP.
errata.guide: 3 TROLL as monster #1 (the digest already marks it [sic])
errata.data: the trolls are monster #31: LOAD MONSTER byte 31, byte 3; MON8CHA.DAX #31 is TROLL and #1 is KOBOLD LEADER (loaded 4 at 0xa4b2)
errata.where: ECL8.DAX block 13 at 0xa49d; MON8CHA.DAX blocks 1 and 31

errata.guide: the heap message of versions 1.2 and earlier
errata.data: not in version 1.3: no ECL text and no text of START.EXE or GAME.OVR has it
errata.noMatch: no script or program text has it
